title: Backport golang-1.25 1.25.14-1 to jammy (LP: #2166409).
description:
Backport golang-1.25 1.25.14-1 to jammy (LP: #2166409).

Build-Depends adjusted to prefer golang-1.24-go as the bootstrap toolchain (golang-1.25 does not exist in jammy). go1.25.14 bootstraps fine from golang-1.24 (minBootstrap = go1.22.6).
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 2749b92..b30268e 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+golang-1.25 (1.25.14-1~22.04.1) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * Backport golang-1.25 1.25.14-1 to jammy (LP: #2166409).
+    - Adjust Build-Depends to prefer golang-1.24-go as the bootstrap
+      toolchain, as golang-1.25 is not available in jammy.
+
+ -- Anshul Singh <anshul.singh@canonical.com>  Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:53:04 +0530
+
 golang-1.25 (1.25.14-1) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream version 1.25.14
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index cad3e1e..7e64d35 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ Section: golang
 Build-Depends:
  debhelper-compat (= 13),
  binutils-gold [arm64],
- golang-1.25-go:native | golang-1.24-go:native,
+ golang-1.24-go:native | golang-1.25-go:native,
  netbase,
 Standards-Version: 4.7.4
 Vcs-Browser: https://salsa.debian.org/go-team/compiler/golang/tree/golang-1.25
diff --git a/debian/control.in b/debian/control.in
index 74e1bf7..b1af37e 100644
--- a/debian/control.in
+++ b/debian/control.in
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ Section: golang

  debhelper-compat (= 13),
  binutils-gold [arm64],
- golang-1.25-go:native | golang-1.24-go:native,
+ golang-1.24-go:native | golang-1.25-go:native,
  netbase,
